Card Q&A.q: When I have a Digimon with [Gabumon]/[Garurumon] in its name and my opponent has 1 level 3 Digimon and 1 level 4 Digimon, can I choose the target to return to the hand for this card's effect from these 2 Digimon?

Effect: [Main] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the hand. If you have a Digimon with [Gabumon] or [Garurumon] in its name, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level to the hand instead.
